narrative.overview: This design system establishes a warm, grounded, and deeply protective atmosphere for voluntary family location sharing. Drawing from the quiet elegance of traditional Vietnamese lacquerware (sơn mài) and organic family hearth aesthetics, the system intentionally rejects the cold, punitive surveillance tropes common in tracking applications. Instead, it frames location awareness as an act of familial care and mutual reassurance ("Đường về nhà, gần hơn mỗi ngày").
keyCharacteristics: Warm Tactile Minimalism: Spacious, breathing-room layouts anchored by soft, pill-shaped interactions, organic silhouettes, and comforting domestic metaphors.
Voluntary & Transparent: Privacy and agency are front-and-center; absence of data or delayed timestamps is presented with calm neutrality rather than alarming red alerts.
Tone & Emotion: Calm, protective, reassuring, domestic, and dependable.
Native Android Material 3: Built on Jetpack Compose Material 3 components and semantic color roles using Vietnamese copy.

rules.name: The Paired Roles Rule
rules.body: Always choose a container and its corresponding content role together (primaryContainer/onPrimaryContainer, secondaryContainer/onSecondaryContainer, errorContainer/onErrorContainer) and verify light/dark contrast via ThemeContrastTest (>= 4.5:1 for body text).

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Map the Be Vietnam Pro scale to Compose MaterialTheme.typography roles using sp units so text respects Android system font-size settings (font_scale 1.3). Never hardcode fixed px sizes in Compose.

rules.name: The Failure Notice Rule
rules.body: Operation failures render as an errorContainer card through a shared error notice component wherever no extra affordances are needed. Bare error-colored text is reserved for destructive action labels and inline cautions about consent conflicts or device/permission state.

rules.name: The Result Notice Rule
rules.body: One-shot confirmations (saved, created, revoked, joined) surface as a Snackbar on screens with a SnackbarHost; surfaces without their own host present results as a secondaryContainer card with an explicit dismiss. Persistent notices use the same card pattern.

dos: Do use semantic Material 3 color roles (MaterialTheme.colorScheme) and test light/dark contrast via ThemeContrastTest.
Do use Be Vietnam Pro mapped through MaterialTheme.typography with sp units and test at font_scale 1.3.
Do use native Compose controls, real Vietnamese text, and dp spacing with 48dp minimum touch targets.
Do preserve explicit unknown, loading, offline, and permission states, keeping consent, system permissions, capture state, and viewer access distinguishable.
Do keep SOS emergency treatment (soft blush) distinct from error (failures), and render stale location data in neutral gray so old data never reads as danger.
Do follow the configured comp-first workflow (.impeccable/config.json) before implementing new screens or redesigns, and verify rendered builds on an emulator or device.
donts: Don't interpret a stale location or missing update as evidence of a person's safety or danger.
Don't hardcode web px/rem values directly into Compose dimensions or bypass MaterialTheme roles.
Don't imply a report has been shared before the user reviews it and explicitly chooses to share.
Don't present static documentation previews, source review, APK builds, or JVM tests as emulator or physical-device validation.
